name: AI Mission Worker V2
description: Validates, reviews, and repairs exactly one generated mission.

parameters.jsCode:
return $input.all().map((item) => ({ json: {
  requirement_id: item.json.requirement_id,
  output_type: item.json.output_type,
  scheduled_date: item.json.scheduled_date,
  mission_type: item.json.mission_type ?? null,
  result: item.json.result,
  validation: item.json.validation,
  review: item.json.review,
  ai_metrics: item.json.ai_metrics ?? { generator: [], reviewer: [], repair: [] },
  failed: false,
  worker_terminal: true,
} }));

const startedAt = Date.now();
return $input.all().map((item) => ({ json: { ...item.json, _reviewer_started_at_ms: startedAt } }));

const startedAt = Date.now();
return $input.all().map((item) => ({ json: { ...item.json, _repair_started_at_ms: startedAt } }));

const startedAt = Date.now();
return $input.all().map((item) => ({ json: { ...item.json, _generator_started_at_ms: startedAt } }));
